Based on the RSC website information I found, here are the names of all Shakespearian tragedies written in the Elizabethan age that were performed by the RSC in-house between 2018 and 2023:

## Answer

The Elizabethan tragedies performed by the RSC in-house between 2018 and 2023 are:

| Year | Play | Director |
|------|------|----------|
| 2018 | **Macbeth** | Polly Findlay |
| 2018 | **Timon of Athens** | Simon Godwin |
| 2023 | **Julius Caesar** | Atri Banerjee |
| 2023 | **Macbeth** | Wils Wilson |

### Note on the 2019 production:
Measure for Measure was performed in 2019 (directed by Gregory Doran), but according to most scholarly classifications (and the RSC's own genre organization), it is typically categorized as either a **problem play** or a **comedy**, rather than a tragedy, so it has been excluded from this list.

### Summary List:
1. **Macbeth** (performed twice - 2018 and 2023)
2. **Timon of Athens** (2018)
3. **Julius Caesar** (2023)

All four of these plays were written during Queen Elizabeth I's reign and are considered among Shakespeare's great tragedies or tragic works according to standard scholarship and the RSC's own classification system.

# Watch RSC shows online
There's no substitute for live theatre (well we would say that), but you can still watch lots of fantastic RSC shows online.

# Watch RSC shows online
## Where to Stream RSC shows
### AMAZON PRIME VIDEO
The most complete collection of Shakespeare’s plays to be captured in widescreen is now available to rent or buy on Amazon Prime Video.
All filmed on stage in Stratford-upon-Avon, the collection spans 35 unforgettable dramas and showcases the very best of British theatre.
Titles include 2024's _A Midsummer Night's Dream_ with Matthew Baynton, Paapa Essiedu's _Hamlet_(2016) _and_ 2018's _Macbeth_ starring Christopher Eccleston.
All these and more are available now to rent or buy on Amazon Prime Video, so you can watch and rewatch your favourite production at the click of a button.

## Where to Stream RSC shows
### Marquee TV
Marquee TV is a monthly subscription arts streaming service showing world-class productions of theatre, opera, ballet and jazz and more.
It currently offers the broadest collection of filmed Shakespeare productions on the wide screen, allowing you to watch a 35-play canon of the RSC's Shakespeare productions (excluding _Henry VIII, Pericles_ and _The_ _Two Noble Kinsmen_).
Highlights include:

*   _Macbeth_ starring Christopher Eccleston (2018)  
*   _Hamlet_ starring Paapa Essiedu (2016)  
*   _Richard II_ starring David Tennant (2013)

# Watch RSC shows online
There's no substitute for live theatre (well we would say that), but you can still watch lots of fantastic RSC shows online.
texts.3:
# Watch RSC shows online
## Where to Stream RSC shows
### AMAZON PRIME VIDEO
The most complete collection of Shakespeare’s plays to be captured in widescreen is now available to rent or buy on Amazon Prime Video.
All filmed on stage in Stratford-upon-Avon, the collection spans 35 unforgettable dramas and showcases the very best of British theatre.
Titles include 2024's _A Midsummer Night's Dream_ with Matthew Baynton, Paapa Essiedu's _Hamlet_(2016) _and_ 2018's _Macbeth_ starring Christopher Eccleston.
All these and more are available now to rent or buy on Amazon Prime Video, so you can watch and rewatch your favourite production at the click of a button.
DISCOVER THE FULL LIST OF TITLES
Watch Christopher Eccleston as Macbeth (2018) on Amazon Prime Video

# Watch RSC shows online
## Where to Stream RSC shows
### Marquee TV
Marquee TV is a monthly subscription arts streaming service showing world-class productions of theatre, opera, ballet and jazz and more.
It currently offers the broadest collection of filmed Shakespeare productions on the wide screen, allowing you to watch a 35-play canon of the RSC's Shakespeare productions (excluding _Henry VIII, Pericles_ and _The_ _Two Noble Kinsmen_).
Highlights include:
*   _A Midsummer Night's Dream_ starring Mathew Baynton (2024)  
*   _Macbeth_ starring Christopher Eccleston (2018)  
*   _Hamlet_ starring Paapa Essiedu (2016)  
*   _Richard II_ starring David Tennant (2013)  
*   _The Tempest_ starring Simon Russell Beale (2016), featuring the first use of live motion capture in a major classical production

## Where to Stream RSC shows
### **Digital Theatre**
Digital Theatre is a one-off rental and subscription streaming service, allowing you to watch over 150 world-class theatre productions from the RSC, Shakespeare's Globe, The Royal Opera House and many more.
You can watch our 34-play RSC Shakespeare collection (the same as featured on Marquee TV, but excludes _A Midsummer Night's Dream_) either by renting individual titles for 48 hours, or by subscribing to the service (monthly or annually).

The groups below are the classification of Shakespeare’s plays according to the First Folio, a collection of 36 of Shakespeare's plays published in 1623 by his colleagues.
